description.zh: 股票是所有权凭证：按份当主人，分红、涨跌都按份来，出事时最后拿钱。债券是借条：出借人不是主人，按约定收票息、到期收回本金，出事时先于股东拿钱。
description.en: A stock is an ownership certificate: you own by part, dividends and price moves follow your parts, and you are paid last when things go wrong. A bond is an IOU: the lender is not an owner, collects coupons as agreed and the principal at maturity, and is paid before shareholders when things go wrong.

reason.zh: 股票是这一课讲的第一种凭证。
reason.en: The stock is the first certificate this lesson explains.

reason.zh: 债券与股票对照：债权对所有权。
reason.en: Bonds contrast with stocks: a lender claim against ownership.

reason.zh: 出事时谁先拿钱，就是风险的来源之一。
reason.en: Who is paid first when things go wrong is one source of risk.

reason.zh: 分散投资拿股债作组合的材料。
reason.en: Diversification builds portfolios from stocks and bonds.

title.zh: 买股票和买债券，到底买到了什么？
title.en: When you buy a stock or a bond, what have you actually bought?

ask.zh: 买到股票，你买到了什么？
ask.en: When you buy a stock, what have you bought?

ask.zh: 股票和债券，关键区别是什么？
ask.en: What is the key difference between a stock and a bond?

ask.zh: 买到债券，你买到了什么？
ask.en: When you buy a bond, what have you bought?
